meta.title: AI Lab
meta.description: Seven experiments in AI-assisted hospitality from Local Host: a trip designer, a voice concierge, photo matching, agency proposals, policy answers, inquiry triage and an AI connector.

title: Local Host *AI Lab*
lead: Where we test how AI can help us host better — for travellers dreaming of the Caucasus, for the agencies who send them, and for our own team in Tbilisi. Every tool hands over to a real person at Local Host.
note: Experimental. Answers are drafts — our team confirms every detail.

cards.title: Trip Designer
cards.text: Pick countries, interests and a month, write a line — and watch a day-by-day draft itinerary appear, ready to send to our team.

cards.title: Voice Concierge
cards.text: Ask out loud about seasons, regions and travel times, and hear the answer in your language.

cards.title: Photo Match
cards.text: Show us a place you love anywhere in the world, and we suggest where in the Caucasus feels the same.

cards.title: Agency Proposal Builder
cards.text: Turn a client brief into a structured programme proposal your agency can adapt and quote.

cards.title: Policy Q&A
cards.text: Ask our sustainability, excursions and accommodation policies a question and get an answer with the source quoted.

cards.title: Inquiry Triage
cards.text: Sorts incoming requests by country, dates and group size, and drafts a first reply for our team to check.

cards.title: AI connector (MCP)
cards.text: A Model Context Protocol server, so a partner’s own AI assistant can look up our experiences, regions and policies.
